note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative: generic clause headings, fictional destination labels ('Law X (fictional)', 'Forum Y (fictional)'), never a real country, legal system or court. The two clauses are separate: the two boards are identical except the clause examined; only the examined clause's signpost moves, the other stays at rest; equal size, weight and timing, no preferred board, and neither decides the other. No conflict-of-laws or jurisdiction doctrine, no validity, effect, priority or outcome. Brief customizable fields not exposed (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, SESSION_HANDOFF 2026-10-05): schedules, definitions, priorities (no ranking between the clauses is shown), actorLabels (no actors), actionProgress and finalState (the hold always shows both boards). objectLabels are the destination plaque labels (destinations); the changed fact is examinedA / examinedB.
